title: Cinnamon Twists
description: A soft, buttery treat with a swirl of spiced sweetness — perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, mix warmed sour cream, warmed milk, melted butter, and beaten egg.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until a soft dough forms.
Knead on a lightly floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and roll out into a large rectangle (approximately 30cm x 40cm).
Brush the surface with 2 tablespoons melted butter.
In a small bowl, mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle evenly over the buttered dough.
Fold the dough in half lengthwise, then cut into strips (about 2cm wide).
Twist each strip gently and place on a lined baking tray, leaving space between each.
Cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). Bake twists for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
While twists cool slightly, make the icing: Beat together butter, vanilla, icing sugar, and milk until smooth and glossy.
Drizzle icing over warm twists and serve.

notes.title: Soft and Tender
notes.content: The sour cream in this recipe creates an exceptionally soft, tender dough. Don't skip warming the dairy — it helps activate the yeast faster.

notes.title: Best Served
notes.content: These are best enjoyed fresh and warm. Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
